implementation: probe.rs includes unchanged production adb_command and adb_mapping modules; production common crate supplies command ownership and native retirement. Rust dependencies pinned in accompanying Cargo.lock.
delayed_outcomes: Wrapper performs real ADB mutations and joins the actual ADB child, then withholds its acknowledgement. Caller cancellation and empty/deleted endpoint observation never substitute for original command/collector/thread retirement.
reconnect: Host requested real ADB USB transport reconnect; observed transport_id 2 -> 3. Android cleared reverse mappings. Original temporary cleanup retained its destination until settlement; Blent independently restored its display mappings. No physical cable removal was requested.
initial_probe_failure: reconnect/result.json preserves the first trial whose immediate baseline-preservation assertion was wrong for native transport reset. first-reconnect-assessment.json distinguishes this oracle correction from production behavior.
conservation: One production mapping at a time, one separately owned control mapping during non-reconnect cases, retained host sockets until cleanup, joined native commands, completion tickets observed before exit. No detached mutation or unfinished proof remains.
final_mappings:
UsbFfs tcp:8890 tcp:8890
UsbFfs tcp:8891 tcp:8891
limits: Selected-device native acceptance with controlled host acknowledgement delays; not arbitrary adbd scheduling, kernel-fault, physical cable-loss or all-device certification. General regression/sanitizer/performance campaigns remain paused.
reproduce_run: run.py requires a clean per-case output directory and the explicitly selected serial; actual effects require a connected authorized device. Preserve artifacts instead of overwriting existing case directories.
